args.message:
fix: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money

Per FIN-212, round_money should round half to even (banker's
rounding). Replace ROUND_HALF_UP with ROUND_HALF_EVEN so that
2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66.

args.head: fix/money-bankers-rounding
args.title: fix: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Change

- Replaced `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`.
- `2.675` now rounds to `2.68` and `2.665` rounds to `2.66`, matching the test expectations.

## Testing

CI passed on branch `fix/money-bankers-rounding` (run `ci-0001`).
